built: 2026-11-14 (MT) cursor/featured-articles-pilot-2026-11-14: lazy factory-featured.js add-on (Jebb 7:36 and 7:38 AM MT asks; 10-file go 7:39 AM MT; v1.2.11 and rooms.json go 7:58 AM MT). Pins new steward articles at the top of For You for site.json featured.featuredDays with a Featured label, adds an Our articles card next to the Porch, X-style Show more after the first paragraph in feed views (a ?p= permalink shows the full post), and post images get alt text, a fixed 16:9 box and https only. Core hooks: addon() loader shared with factory-signin.js, PLUGIN.feat after renderFeed and paintRail, https check in renderPostMedia; rail CSS now uses addCss. Prior: 2026-11-12 (MT) cursor/signin-popup-redirect-2026-11-12: blocked Google popup falls back to signInWithRedirect (v1.2.9 design); a blocked notice replaces the normal button block instead of sitting next to it; 18+ gate unchanged. Phone cat (prior): top bar reserves space for the 44px cat (tune --cat, default 7.05rem) and a light #fff backing with #111 ink; desktop cat color is var(--nav-text,#fff)

factory-gp.js.loadWhen: site.json features.watchlist|topicFollow|sessionSeeds true, or rail.kind f1-calendar (gpchat only today)

factory-rail.js.loadWhen: site.json rail.kind nws-forecast|nws-cwf|bart-bsa, or rail.forecastUrl / rail.lat+lon (415, 808, samo, bart)

factory-reports.js.loadWhen: site.json features.reportLoop true (A9 report loop; airlineschat/amachat first once unkilled)

factory-signin.js.loadWhen: lazy, prefetched at factory boot so a Google tap can call signInWithPopup in the same gesture; a blocked popup (or a silent iOS / in-app failure) falls back to signInWithRedirect; also handles redirect result, email, register, email-already-in-use, forgot password, the join-sheet layout, and the in-app-browser Open in your browser note

factory-featured.js.loadWhen: lazy, only when site.json has a featured block (featuredDays, maxPinned, articleMinChars, label, handles); cobrachat pilot first
